name: 加熱式たばこを喫煙規制の対象に
summary: 現在の条例では、喫煙を、たばこに火をつけて煙を出すこととして定めています。議案では、たばこの定義を加え、加熱して煙や蒸気を出す場合も喫煙に含めます。
changes: たばこを健康増進法第28条第1号に規定するものと定める
喫煙に、たばこを燃焼または加熱して出る煙（蒸気を含む）を含める
who: 加熱式たばこを使う人
why: 区たばこルールの喫煙制限に加熱式たばこを含めるため、たばこの定義を加え、喫煙の定義を見直すためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Brings heated tobacco under smoking restrictions
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Setagaya City Ordinance on Environmental Beautification, etc.
en.summary: The current ordinance defines smoking as lighting tobacco and producing smoke. The bill adds a definition of tobacco and includes producing smoke or vapor by heating tobacco in the definition of smoking.
changes: Defines tobacco as that specified in Article 28, item 1 of the Health Promotion Act
Includes smoke (including vapor) produced by burning or heating tobacco in the definition of smoking
en.why: The ward says it is adding a definition of tobacco and revising the definition of smoking so that heated tobacco is covered by the smoking restrictions in the ward's tobacco rules.
